name: assistant.send-guest-message
reason: A guest's message to the buyer assistant: a guest has no account or session. The conversation answers only the assistant's own guest cookie that started it; Market settings decide whether guests may chat (off by default), and per-origin and per-guest message limits apply.

name: assistant.view-storefront-assistant
reason: The storefront asks whether to show the buyer assistant to a visitor who may have no session; the answer is the safe subset only (on for this visitor, guests allowed, reply language, welcome text) and changes nothing.

name: cart.add-guest-item
reason: A guest adds to the cart held by the cart cookie: a guest has no account or session.

name: cart.remove-guest-item
reason: A guest removes a line of the cart held by the cart cookie: a guest has no account or session.

name: cart.set-guest-line-quantity
reason: A guest changes a line of the cart held by the cart cookie: a guest has no account or session.

name: cart.view-guest-cart
reason: The guest cart is read with the cart cookie of the browser: a guest has no account or session.

name: catalog.category-tree
reason: The buyer site's left menu and Browse drawer for a visitor with no session: the live platform category tree (ids, slugs, names, order); no seller category, no count, nothing unpublished.

name: catalog.published-image-read
reason: The buyer site shows product photos to a visitor with no session: one rendition (thumb, medium or large) of a photo that is in the current published revision of a published product and is not taken down; every other case answers the same not-found. JPEG written by the server, sandboxed, nosniff, never a cookie.

name: engagement.record-block-events
reason: The storefront reports that blocks of a published page were shown or clicked, for a visitor with no session: 1 to 20 events of page id, placement id and impression or click, counted into one row per block and UTC day, only for a placement the page's published version serves now (others are skipped without a sign). No session, cookie, address or user agent is read or kept; Sec-GPC: 1 counts nothing; always 204 and no-store; rate limited per origin.

name: engagement.record-guest-event
reason: The storefront records what a guest viewed, searched for or added to the cart under the engagement guest cookie (30 days): a guest has no account or session; ids only, and Sec-GPC records nothing.

name: identity.accept-admin-invitation
reason: Admin invitation acceptance with the mailed token: the invitee has no session yet.

name: identity.accept-seller-invitation
reason: Seller Owner invitation acceptance with the mailed token (slice 9): the invitee has no account or session yet.

name: identity.complete-admin-sign-in
reason: Second step of admin sign-in with the pending sign-in ticket: no session exists until it passes.

name: identity.complete-seller-sign-in
reason: Second step of seller sign-in with the pending sign-in ticket: no session exists until it passes.

name: identity.confirm-customer-email
reason: Customer email-confirmation link: the visitor is not signed in yet.

name: identity.confirm-second-factor-enrolment
reason: Admin second-factor enrolment confirmation with the enrolment challenge token and the first code: no session exists yet.

name: identity.confirm-seller-email
reason: Seller email-confirmation link: the visitor is not signed in yet.

name: identity.confirm-seller-second-factor-enrolment
reason: Seller second-factor enrolment confirmation with the enrolment challenge token and the first code: the challenge binds the account and every session ends.

name: identity.confirm-seller-second-factor-reset
reason: The Seller Owner confirms, with the single-use 24-hour link of E15, a second-factor reset an admin started: the link binds the account, the owner may not be signed in (A11).

name: identity.describe-social-sign-in
reason: The storefront asks which sign-in providers the Market offers, to show their buttons to a visitor who has no session; configuration only.

name: identity.register-customer
reason: Customer sign-up form.

name: identity.register-seller
reason: Seller sign-up form.

name: identity.request-customer-verification
reason: Resend of the customer verification mail; the answer never reveals whether the account exists.

name: identity.request-password-reset
reason: Password-reset mail request by a visitor who cannot sign in.

name: identity.request-seller-verification
reason: Resend of the seller verification mail; the answer never reveals whether the account exists.

name: identity.reset-password
reason: Password reset with the mailed link by a visitor who cannot sign in.

name: identity.sign-in-admin
reason: Admin sign-in first step: the caller has no session.

name: identity.sign-in-customer
reason: Customer sign-in: the caller has no session yet.

name: identity.sign-in-seller
reason: Seller sign-in: the caller has no session yet.

name: identity.sign-in-with-provider
reason: Customer sign-in or sign-up through a sign-in provider's redirect: the caller has no session yet.

name: identity.start-admin-invitation-acceptance
reason: Start of admin invitation acceptance with the mailed token: the invitee has no session yet.

name: identity.start-second-factor-enrolment
reason: Admin second-factor enrolment start with the mailed enrolment link's token and the password: the admin has no session yet.

name: identity.start-social-sign-in
reason: The first step of signing in with a provider: the caller has no session yet; nothing is stored.

name: notifications.unsubscribe-marketing-email
reason: One-click unsubscribe of a marketing mail (RFC 8058, Spam Act): the mail client or the reader has no session; the signed token names the account and can only withdraw consent.

name: notifications.view-public-support-contact
reason: The sign-in pages of both panels show the Market's support email to a visitor who has no session; the answer is the address only.

name: notifications.view-unsubscribe-link
reason: The storefront unsubscribe page checks the mail link before the reader confirms: no session; changes nothing.

name: payments.receive-stripe-event
reason: Stripe calls the webhook without a session: the Stripe-Signature over the raw body, checked first in the use case, authenticates the event; it only stores the event for the worker.

name: reviews.list-product-reviews
reason: The product page lists a product's published reviews for a visitor with no session: published reviews only, the author shown as a short name or Verified buyer, never an account id, email or order id; reviews are off in a Market until an admin switches them on.

name: reviews.view-product-summary
reason: The product page and listings show a product's star summary to a visitor with no session: counts and averages only, no author or text.

name: reviews.view-seller-summary
reason: The store page shows a seller's rated-order summary to a visitor with no session: counts, averages and shares only, no buyer or order identity.

name: search.list-bestsellers
reason: The storefront best-sellers shelf for a visitor with no session: Offer ids, text and category ids in rank order (no sales figure), each re-checked against catalog and sellers; rate limited per origin.

name: search.list-bought-together
reason: The product page's bought-together shelf for a visitor with no session: Offer ids, text and category ids in rank order (no order count), from pairs of at least 3 distinct paid orders over 90 days, the asked Offer never included, each re-checked against catalog and sellers; nothing about the shopper is read; no-store; rate limited per origin.

name: search.list-for-you-guest
reason: The storefront for-you shelf for a guest: a guest has no account or session. The guest is the engagement guest cookie's token, read only with Engagement-Consent: granted and without Sec-GPC: 1; otherwise the shelf is the Market's best sellers. Offer ids, text and category ids only, each re-checked against catalog and sellers; no-store, never sets a cookie; rate limited per origin.

name: search.list-recently-viewed-guest
reason: The storefront recently-viewed shelf for a guest: a guest has no account or session. The guest is the engagement guest cookie's token, read only with Engagement-Consent: granted and without Sec-GPC: 1; otherwise the list is empty. Offer ids, text and category ids only, each re-checked against catalog and sellers; no-store, never sets a cookie; rate limited per origin.

name: search.list-specials
reason: The storefront specials shelf for a visitor with no session: Offers on special now with the special and regular buyer price (never Cost), each re-checked against catalog and sellers; rate limited per origin.

name: search.search-products
reason: The public storefront search: a visitor with no session finds sellable Offers by text or category; the answer is ids, text and category ids, re-checked against catalog and sellers, and the route is rate limited per origin.

name: search.view-product-detail
reason: The storefront product page for a visitor with no session: the published product text and variants and its sellable Offers with buyer price (never Cost), public stock state (never the exact count) and the seller's public store name; re-checked against catalog and sellers; rate limited per origin.

name: sellers.published-store-image-read
reason: The buyer site's store logo and banner for a visitor with no session: the current image of a store that may sell now, as the JPEG the server wrote (no metadata, no upload kept); an unknown slug, a replaced or removed image, another store's image and a store that may not sell all answer the same not-found.

name: sellers.published-store-list
reason: The buyer site's sellers page for a visitor with no session: the allow-listed public fields (slug, store name, ServiceArea code, year of first approval, minimum order) of stores that may sell now; no address, contact or identifier, nothing about a seller that may not sell, no key unwrapped.

name: sellers.published-store-read
reason: The buyer site's store page for a visitor with no session: one held slug's allow-listed public fields, only while the seller may sell; an unknown, retired or not-selling slug answers the same not-found.

name: shipping.delivery-area
reason: The buyer site asks whether the Market delivers to a postcode before sign-in (cart, checkout, Deliver to): the answer is the public ServiceArea configuration; nothing about a person is read or stored.

name: shipping.receive-carrier-webhook
reason: Mondapac Drive's status webhook: the caller is the carrier, which holds no session. The use case refuses anything without a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature of the timestamp and the raw body under the Market's webhook secret, within a 300-second replay window; each event is taken once by its id, and it only moves a seller order's carrier delivery forward.

name: shipping.receive-uber-webhook
reason: Uber Direct's status webhook: the caller is Uber, which holds no session. The use case answers not-found while the fleet is off for the Market or has no webhook secret there (the same answer, so an unsigned caller cannot tell the configuration apart) and refuses anything without a valid hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body (x-uber-signature) under the Market's webhook secret; each event is taken once by its id, the booking is found by Uber's delivery id within the Market and fleet, and it only moves a seller order's carrier delivery forward.

name: shipping.view-store-flat-fee
reason: The buyer site's store page for a visitor with no session: the flat shipping fee of one store by its public address, only while the seller may sell; an unknown, retired or not-selling store and a store with no fee answer the same not-found.

name: storefront.view-published-landing-page
reason: A visitor with no session reads a live landing page at /l/<slug>: only a published, unarchived page inside its live window, or the site path an old or archived slug now sends to; layout and settings only, no product data.

name: storefront.view-published-navigation
reason: The buyer site's left rail and Browse drawer for a visitor with no session: only the version a platform admin approved (or the empty default); labels, category ids and site paths only.

name: storefront.view-published-page
reason: The buyer site draws a system page (home, cart, ...) for a visitor with no session: only the published layout, or the template's code defaults; layout and settings only, no product data.

name: storefront.view-published-slides
reason: The buyer site draws the slider of a position (home hero, ...) for a visitor with no session: only approved slides of the request's Market inside their window whose link target is alive in that Market (a suspended seller or a dead link drops the slide); plain texts, ready-made image keys and site paths only; cache-control at most 60 seconds and never past the next start or end.
